heroSummary: Northside ISD students begin the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 9, 2027. The last day of school is Wednesday, May 24, 2028. Spring break is March 6–10, followed by a teacher planning day on March 13, so students return Tuesday, March 14. Students are off October 8–12, creating a five-day break including the weekend. February 22 is reserved as a possible bad-weather makeup day and should be confirmed before making plans.

calendarNotes: Northside ISD students begin school August 9, 2027, after teacher workdays August 2–6, and finish May 24, 2028. Students have a five-day break October 8–12. Winter break runs December 20–31, with a teacher planning day January 3. February 22 is a possible bad-weather makeup day. Spring break runs March 6–10, followed by a teacher planning day March 13. The district also lists a school holiday Friday, April 28.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2026–27
content: The first student day moves from August 10 to August 9.
The possible bad-weather makeup day moves from February 16 to February 22.
The last student day moves from May 26 to May 24.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of Northside ISD school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Students’ first day of school is Monday, August 9, 2027. Teachers have scheduled workdays August 2–6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Northside ISD spring break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring break is March 6–10, 2028. Monday, March 13 is a teacher planning day, so students return Tuesday, March 14.

calendarFaqs.q: Will Northside ISD students have school on February 22, 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: February 22 is reserved as a possible bad-weather makeup day. Students may attend if the district uses it to recover lost instructional time; otherwise, it remains a student holiday and staff development day.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the official Northside ISD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link above. The separate ICS file is created by MySchoolDates and does not update automatically.

calendarFaqs.q: Is this Northside ISD in San Antonio or Northwest ISD near Fort Worth?
calendarFaqs.a: This page covers Northside Independent School District in San Antonio, whose official website is nisd.net. Northwest Independent School District serves the Dallas–Fort Worth area and uses nisdtx.org.
